'''Frostbite Lake''' was a frozen lake located on the eastern [[Icefall Plains/Legends|Icefall Plains]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. During the [[Galactic War]], [[Talz/Legends|Talz]] commandos established camps along the western edge of the lake.
